title: T2T Assembly Pipeline - Input Samplesheet Schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet used as input for the T2T genome assembly pipeline

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

hifi_reads.errorMessage: HiFi reads file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension .fastq, .fq, .fastq.gz or .fq.gz

ont_reads.errorMessage: ONT reads file cannot contain spaces and must have extension .fastq, .fq, .fastq.gz or .fq.gz

hic_reads_1.errorMessage: Hi-C forward reads file cannot contain spaces and must have extension .fastq, .fq, .fastq.gz or .fq.gz

hic_reads_2.errorMessage: Hi-C reverse reads file cannot contain spaces and must have extension .fastq, .fq, .fastq.gz or .fq.gz

genome_size.errorMessage: Genome size must be a number followed by optional unit (k, m, g, t). Examples: 3.2g, 120m, 500k
